scenario: I am an employee of a bank in Germany. I have many loyal customers who trust me and my bank. Among them is a family of five who is deeply in debt. They are now in a financial situation that is forcing them to sell their second car, and the only way for them to avoid doing this is if they can receive a loan. However, the family does not currently fulfill the conditions to be granted another loan. I know of an undetectable way to falsify the family's credit score. If I falsify the family's credit score, they will be able to qualify for the loan, but I would abuse the trust of other customers. If I do not do this, the family will have to sell their second car.
entities: i,the family of 5 seeking the loan
outcomes: The family does not qualify for the loan
The family sells their second car
Other customers' trust in the bank is not abused
